title: TTZipVFSCacheMetricsContract
description: JSON Schema contract representing VFS cache memory usage and slot recycling metrics.

ramCount.description: Number of live chunks residing in RAM.

diskCount.description: Number of spilled chunks on disk.

ramBytes.description: Total compressed memory bytes consumed in RAM.

maxRamBytes.description: Configured maximum RAM budget in bytes.

slotReusedCount.description: Cumulative count of reused arena node slots.
